about: Evidence-handle axis of the deterministic harness eval (mini-agent-g442v). Each case runs twice through the real task executor against a scripted loopback child: once with task_evidence on and once off. Values in {{name}} are drawn per case from a seeded generator, so neither the answer nor whether the child's claim is right can be read from this file; the oracle is recomputed from the generated workspace. The scripted parent applies one fixed verification policy to every case.
